profile.headline:
IT Full Stack Developer
elysiumsolutions.net
profile.summary: A results-driven Business Applications Specialist with a strong background in full-stack development and process automation. Proven ability to architect, deploy, and manage business-critical applications that optimize workflows and deliver significant cost savings. Adept at collaborating with stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into secure, scalable technical solutions.

positions.title: IT Solutions Architect & Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
- In 10 weeks, I planned, developed, tested, and deployed a software application that digitized and automated Aspen’s billing and data processes. This software application saves the company over 130 hours in administrative work a week and over $130,000 dollars a year.
- Developed secure security measures to be in compliance with HIPAA including proper JWT token management, Multi-Factor Authentication, backend and front end security checks, comprehensive audit logs, password hashing, and secure password reset features. As a part of this, I also wrote legal documents for security responses per HIPAA requirements. 
- Set up and managed a Linux server where the application was hosted using Caddy HTTPS encryption, OpenVPN for ssh features, and secure port forwarding for a web domain for ease of access for company employees.
- Built a git system for smooth development and deployment of updates.
 - Coordinated with business stakeholders to establish expectations, fulfill company needs, and establish timelines. 
- Led a group of employees in beta testing the application and ensured it was highly reliable.
- Created Notion Project Management system for task and sprint tracking.

positions.title: Behavior Intervention Specialist
positions.locationName: Idaho Falls, Idaho, United States · On-site

positions.title: Information Technology Business Analyst
positions.description:
●	Managed cross-functional collaboration to deliver 5 advanced IT business projects that spanned over North America, Europe, and Australia for a multibillion dollar company.
●	Creatively utilized multiple tools such as SQL, spreadsheets, and lower software environments to perform GAP analysis to find solutions to complex issues. 
●	Coordinated with stakeholders and concisely communicated business needs to software developers.
positions.insights: Problem Solving, Cross-team Collaboration and +12 skills

positions.title: Customer Service Supervisor
positions.description:
-Analyzed workforce motivation by sending out a survey created from validated peer-reviewed scales measuring types of motivation and then creating an R Studio code that automatically summarizes the data.
-Graded calls and provided feedback to ensure quality customer service.
-Helped team members set and reach goals.
-Created a team atmosphere that cultivates positivity, high performance, and growth. 
-Played an integral part in onboarding team members.
-Sought to be supportive to team members and to provide them an experience that cultivates trust and increases retention. 
-Used disciplinary action if needed to correct inappropriate behavior.

positions.title: Customer Service Coach
positions.description: Helped train new employees on how to provide world class customer service. Supported and coached many current employees on how to reach their goals in mastering their craft.

positions.title: Missionary
positions.description:
-Befriended and served people of all faiths and backgrounds.
-Learned how to be bold and confident while also being kind, gentle, and loving towards people.
-Worked closely and lived with many different people with many different types of personalities and learned how to get along with all of them.
-Learned how to teach and present information effectively and succinctly in a way that is tailored to each individual's needs.
positions.insights: Organization Skills, Public Speaking and +7 skills

company.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description:
-Upsold items to paying customers to increase revenue for each transaction. This was especially important since our restaurant was already constantly busy with customers almost all day every day. The most effective way to increase profit was not by an increase of customers, but an increase of how much the customers would buy.
-Worked with coworkers to prepare and get products out to customers as quickly as possible while making sure the customers felt loved, respected, and appreciated.
-Served customers by topping off drinks and anticipating condiments, napkins and other needs.
-Juggled many different responsibilities at the same time such as restocking, greeting and interacting with customers, preparing meals, cleaning, taking orders, delivering meals in a way that would give customers the best experience.
positions.insights: Interpersonal Skills, Customer Service and +1 skill
